The member lookup through a BaseHandler reference resolves statically to BaseHandler::handle, not to the selected ConsoleHandler declaration, even though virtual dispatch reaches the override at runtime.
The member call through the concrete ConsoleHandler alias resolves to the selected ConsoleHandler::handle declaration.
